title: China and Oil Shocks Push Climate Down Pacific Islands’ Agenda
title_cn: 中国和石油危机使太平洋岛国的气候议程被推迟
summary: For years, the Pacific islands managed something remarkable — some of the smallest nations in the world persuaded their larger, more powerful allies that climate change was the region’s defining security challenge and pushed them to act.

title: US Military Is in 'Satisfactory Shape': Ret. General
title_cn: 退役军人：美国军队状况“令人满意”一般的
summary: US Air Force General (Ret.) Charles Wald pushes back on concerns that the US has depleted too much of its advanced weapons stockpile, saying the military remains in “pretty good shape” and can provide air cover over the Strait of Hormuz "indefinitely." The former Deputy Commander of United States European Command also weighs in on a report that President Donald Trump was moved off Air Force One amid a potential threat. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dems Can't Compel AI CEOs to Testify: Rep. McClellan
title_cn: 民主党不能强迫人工智能首席执行官作证：众议员麦克莱伦
summary: Representative Jennifer McClellan (D-VA) says she has yet to hear back from House Speaker Mike Johnson after calling for hearings with major AI executives, and acknowledges Democrats have limited ability in the minority to compel them to testify. The Virginia Democrat says Congress needs bipartisan action on AI safeguards and weighs in on her party's path forward as more progressive candidates compete in Democratic primaries. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
